description: This Java file defines a REST controller for percentage calculations, exposing an endpoint '/percent' that computes a percentage of a number based on query parameters.

classes.name: PercentController
classes.description: REST controller providing an endpoint to compute a percentage of a number.

methods.name: percent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to calculate percentage based on query parameters 'a' and 'b'. Validates input and returns the computed result or errors.
